## Details

<a id="swap_block_col13"></a>
### [`swap_block_col13`](../../../../src/story/end_swaps.asm#L6) `$8BCA`

*routine*

Swaps the 4x4-character picture block at row 9, column 13 with block_store_a. Also swaps its 16 colour RAM bytes with block_colours_a. A second call undoes the swap. In part 1, only quit_to_demo calls it, when final_stage bit 7 is set.
Bitmap $6ba8 = row 9, column 13.

- **Called from:** [`quit_to_demo`](../main/quit_to_demo.md#quit_to_demo)
- **Calls:** [`swap_block_4x4`](end_swaps.md#swap_block_4x4)
- **Writes:** [`copy_src_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#copy_src_ptr), [`copy_dst_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#copy_dst_ptr), [`screen_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#screen_ptr), [`bitmap_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#bitmap_ptr)
- **Refers to:** [`copy_src_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#copy_src_ptr), [`copy_dst_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#copy_dst_ptr), [`screen_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#screen_ptr), [`bitmap_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#bitmap_ptr)

Swaps the 4x4-character picture block at row 9, column 23 with block_store_b. Also swaps its 16 colour RAM bytes with block_colours_b. A second call undoes the swap. In part 1, only quit_to_demo calls it, when final_stage bit 7 is set.
Bitmap $6bf8 = row 9, column 23.
